# Breadcrumb

Figma: [06f. Breadcrumb](https://www.figma.com/design/a7Z956YZy9n6f9uz5DK16Y?node-id=69-936) · Family: 06 Navigation · Status: stable · Version 2.0.0 · Updated 2026-06-15

A horizontal trail showing where the current page sits in the hierarchy, and a one-tap way back up. Built from two atoms - BreadcrumbItem and BreadcrumbSeparator - with full and collapsed variants across LTR + RTL.

Reference image (every variant, labelled): `knowledge/examples/components/breadcrumb/reference.png`

### BreadcrumbItem

One segment of a Breadcrumb trail: a muted link to an ancestor level, brand and underlined on hover, or the bold non-link current page.

Level: atom · Part of: Breadcrumb

Use when:
- Inside Breadcrumb; set Label per item, showIcon on the root (home) item, State=current on the last

Don't use when:
- Standalone links in text: use Link
- Step labels in a flow: use Stepper

Accessibility: Current item uses aria-current=page and is not a link; home icon item still needs a text label.

| Property in Figma | Code name | Type | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| showIcon | `showIcon` | boolean |  | false |
| Label | `label` | text |  | Page |
| State | `state` | variant | default, hover, current | default |
| Direction | `direction` | variant | LTR, RTL | LTR |

### BreadcrumbSeparator

The chevron between breadcrumb items, pointing in the reading direction and mirroring in RTL.

Level: atom · Part of: Breadcrumb

Use when:

Don't use when:

### Breadcrumb

Single-line trail from the top of the hierarchy to the current page (Home > Investments > Active Deals > Deal #1024) for orientation in deep web and back-office structures. A secondary aid, never the primary navigation.

Level: organism · Contains: BreadcrumbItem, BreadcrumbSeparator

Use when:
- Back-office and web pages three or more levels deep
- Users landing deep from search or a shared link
- Long trails that must stay on one line (Type=collapsed with an ellipsis)

Don't use when:
- Flat one or two level structures: omit it
- Sequential flows like KYC or checkout: use Stepper
- Mobile app screens: use AppBar with BackButton
- As the only navigation: pair with NavigationRail, AppSidebar (shadcn-style) or TabBar

Accessibility: nav aria-label=Breadcrumb with an ordered list; last item aria-current=page; never wrap or truncate labels.

| Property in Figma | Code name | Type | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Type | `type` | variant | full, collapsed | full |
| Direction | `direction` | variant | LTR, RTL | LTR |

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

A breadcrumb shows the path from the top of the hierarchy down to the current page, and lets people jump back up a level in one tap. It is a secondary aid - it supplements primary navigation, it never replaces it.

### When to use

- Deep, hierarchical content - a deal inside a category inside a portfolio - where people need to know where they are.
- Sites/apps where users often arrive deep (from search or a link) and need orientation.

### When not to use

- Flat structures with one or two levels - a breadcrumb adds clutter with no payoff.
- As the only or primary navigation - pair it with an AppBar or TabBar.

### Live preview

### Atomic architecture

Two atoms compose the trail; the organism just alternates them.

### Atoms

- BreadcrumbItem - one segment. State default (link), hover (brand + underline), current (bold, non-link). Optional leading icon (showIcon) and a Label.
- BreadcrumbSeparator - the chevron between items; mirrors automatically in RTL.

### Organism

- Breadcrumb - Item / Separator / … / Item(current). Variants: full and collapsed (···) × Direction.

> **Info:** Only the last item is State=current; every earlier item is a link. Edit each item’s Label, and turn showIcon on for the first (home) segment.

### Anatomy

Left to right (or right to left in RTL): root → … → current.

- Root item - usually Home, with the leading icon, linking to the top level.
- Intermediate items - links to each ancestor level.
- Separator - a chevron pointing in the reading direction.
- Current item - the page you are on; bold, not a link.
- Overflow (···) - replaces the middle items when the trail is too long.

### States

Item states. The current item is the only non-link.

default · link

hover

current · page

- default - text/muted link to an ancestor level.
- hover - text/brand/primary with an underline, signalling it is clickable.
- current - text/default, semibold; marks the page and is not interactive (aria-current="page").

### Variants

Two shapes for the same trail.

full

Every level shown. Use when the path is short (up to ~4 levels) and fits on one line.

collapsed

Root · ··· · current. Collapse the middle when the trail is long or space is tight; the ··· reveals the hidden levels.

### Direction - LTR and RTL

The whole trail and every chevron reverse with direction.

LTR

Root on the left, current on the right; chevrons point right.

RTL

Root on the right, current on the left; chevrons point left; Noto Sans Arabic.

### Behavior

- Single line - a breadcrumb never wraps. When it doesn’t fit, collapse the middle to ··· rather than truncating labels.
- Keep it to ~4 visible levels; the ··· holds the rest and expands on tap.
- The current (last) item is never a link - it’s where you already are.
- Labels mirror the page titles exactly, so the trail is predictable.

> **Warning:** Don’t put the current page’s actions in the breadcrumb, and don’t use it as a wizard/progress indicator - use a Stepper (06h) for that.

### Code examples

### HTML · ARIA

```dart
<nav aria-label="Breadcrumb">
  <ol class="breadcrumb">
    <li><a href="/">Home</a></li>
    <li><a href="/investments">Investments</a></li>
    <li><a href="/investments/active">Active Deals</a></li>
    <li><span aria-current="page">Deal #1024</span></li>
  </ol>
</nav>
<!-- separators drawn with CSS ::before; never inside the link text -->
```

### Usage - Do and Don’t

Do

Do show the full path and mark the current page bold and non-clickable.

Don’t

Don’t use a breadcrumb as the primary or only navigation - pair it with an AppBar or TabBar.

Do

Do collapse a long trail to ··· on one line - never wrap to a second line or truncate labels.

Don’t

Don’t make the current item a link, and don’t hide the current page inside the ··· overflow.

### Siblings

- AppBar (06a) - top navigation bar
- TabBar (06b) - section navigation
- Stepper (06h) - for sequential progress (not hierarchy)

### Notes from the maintainer

> **Info:** Two breadcrumb-specific atoms: BreadcrumbItem (default · hover · current + showIcon + Label) and BreadcrumbSeparator (auto-mirrors in RTL). The organism just alternates them.

> **Info:** Set each item’s Label, turn showIcon on for the root (home), and set the last item to State=current. The home icon is swappable per instance.

> **Warning:** The Label TEXT prop has one default (“Page”) shared LTR/RTL - always set the real label per item. RTL items use Noto Sans Arabic.
